desc: Implement sorted interval representation and strict non-overlap jump targets using `start > end`.
Implement bottom-up suffix DP for up to 4 intervals with skip/take transitions.
Verify sample cases and edge cases: one interval, equal-weight alternatives, touching endpoints, and fewer than 4 selections.
Confirm sorted original-index tuples apply the exact required lexicographic tie-break.
Confirm `O(n log n + 4n)` time and acceptable memory.
